title: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A loxodon Lorehold student and archaeologist who leads the search for the Invocation of the Founders and sacrifices himself to power it.

entities.name: Rootha
entities.description: A Prismari student who freezes water and fires blasts, and whose petal of the invocation goes dark when Dean Nassari attacks.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A Witherbloom student with a bag of pests who helps build the ritual that blasts a hole through the Biblioplex.

entities.name: Zimone
entities.description: A Quandrix student who contributes growth theory to Dina's ritual and worries about her grandmother Nimiroti.

entities.name: Killian
entities.description: A Silverquill student who casts ink spells and whose father Embrose Lu is helping them.

entities.name: Embrose Lu
entities.description: Killian's father and a Silverquill dean who fights Phyrexianized professors with a storm of ink.

entities.name: Dean Shaile
entities.description: A compleated owlin dean with a web mouth who seizes Killian.

entities.name: Dean Nassari
entities.description: A compleated dean with a mechanical heart body who destroys Rootha's ice and attacks the casters.

entities.name: Dean Herrian the Second
entities.description: A spirit bound into a statue whom Quint summons to guide them.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and Strixhaven professor who protects the dormitories with undead and treats the wounded students.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A planeswalker who suggested an ember lay among the students.

entities.name: Will
entities.description: A friend of Quint he has not seen since the invasion.

entities.name: Rowan
entities.description: A friend of Quint he has not seen since the invasion.

entities.name: Nimiroti
entities.description: Zimone's grandmother whom Zimone begs Liliana to save.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven under invasion.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university under Phyrexian siege.

entities.name: The Biblioplex
entities.description: Strixhaven's vast library, overrun by red sinew and the Invasion Tree.

entities.name: Zantafar
entities.description: A lost city Quint once found.

entities.name: The Invocation of the Founders
entities.description: A living spell of letters that describes Strixhaven and was crafted from the power of the five elder dragons, which the students cast to drive back Phyrexia.

entities.name: The Invasion Tree
entities.description: The Phyrexian World Tree whose branches pierce Strixhaven.

entities.name: Phyrexianized professors
entities.description: Compleated faculty who hunt the students in the Biblioplex.

entities.name: Strixhaven students
entities.description: Students of the five colleges defending the school.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde besieging Strixhaven.

entities.name: The five elder dragons
entities.description: Dragons whose power was melded into the invocation.

events.summary: Quint and four students search the tunnels beneath Strixhaven for the Invocation of the Founders.
events.quote: I wonder if the invocation will really slow the Phyrexian invasion, like Professor Vess said.

events.summary: Quint summons the spirit of Dean Herrian the Second from a statue, who reveals they are directly under the Biblioplex.
events.quote: How can you be lost when you're under the Biblioplex?

events.summary: The students climb into the Biblioplex and find it overrun by red sinew and the Invasion Tree, with the invocation's motes fighting the gloom.
events.quote: His lovely, luminous center of learning was gone.

events.summary: A dwarf student calls for help and is dragged away by a compleated figure, and Quint's cry draws Dean Shaile's attention.
events.quote: Dean Shaile's head abruptly swiveled around.

events.summary: The students flee through the Biblioplex, fighting back with magic.
events.quote: They didn't even speak. They just ran.

events.summary: Dean Shaile seizes Killian, demanding the whereabouts of his father.
events.quote: Where is your father?

events.summary: Dean Embrose Lu arrives in a storm of ink that melts compleated professors and rescues Killian.
events.quote: Dean Embrose Lu landed beside them.

events.summary: Embrose flings the students out of the fight so they can find the invocation, and Killian sends him supportive words.
events.quote: And without warning lashes of black whipped around the students' torsos

events.summary: The students sneak through the Biblioplex avoiding patrolling professors, and Quint summons a statue spirit that shouts at a professor to save Zimone.
events.quote: No talking in the library!

events.summary: They find the Invocation of the Founders on a platform and discover it is partially alive and shields them from Phyrexian attention.
events.quote: It's protecting us from Phyrexian attention.

events.summary: Dina and Zimone build a ritual to blast a hole to open air, while a professor attacks and the invocation folds into a pocket-sized ball.
events.quote: he grabbed it and rammed it into his pocket, out of sight

events.summary: The ritual's overload turns the Biblioplex's bookcases into a huge tree that smashes through the ceiling.
events.quote: and kept growing , boughs forming a perfect helix of steps

events.summary: The students read the five petals of the invocation on the roof, describing Strixhaven's nature back to itself.
events.quote: They told Strixhaven what it was, and in that telling, there was no room for Phyrexia.

events.summary: Dean Nassari shatters Rootha's ice wall and attacks her, making her petal go dark and the invocation fail.
events.quote: The invocation was failing

events.summary: Quint grabs Rootha's petal and pours his life into the invocation to complete it.
events.quote: he powered the invocation with his life alone

events.summary: A light erupts from Quint, wrecking the Biblioplex and Dean Nassari, closing the portals and swallowing Quint.
events.quote: Dean Nassari was flung from the rooftop

events.summary: The students emerge from the dormitory to ruin, with Liliana directing survivors and tending the wounded.
events.quote: but ruin

events.summary: Liliana finds Dina, Killian, Zimone and Rootha injured, and Killian digs out his father alive.
events.quote: but alive, and himself.

events.summary: Dina reports that Quint vanished in a burst of light, and Liliana wonders if he sparked.
events.quote: If Quint's spark ignited, he could still be alive

events.summary: Liliana raises an undead army to hold the ruins against the returning Phyrexian portals.
events.quote: Skeletons and zombies erupted from the ground

relations.quote: still more ink flashed upward to shred the filaments of Dean Shaile's mouth
Under Liliana's instructions, they built up what defenses they could

relations.note: former dean who criticizes and attacks her
